beliefs: f removes all whitespace characters (spaces, tabs, newlines) from the input and appends 'F' to the end [E1, E2]
f preserves case, punctuation, digits, and other non-whitespace characters unchanged [E2]
notes: E2 showed tabs and newlines are also removed, so I generalized from removing only spaces to removing all whitespace (using split/join or regex). Everything else (case, punctuation, digits) is preserved and 'F' is appended.
